UC-1440.en: Clauseo needs your Mac's permission to read its saved keys.
UC-1440.hi: Clauseo को अपनी सहेजी गई कुंजियाँ पढ़ने के लिए आपके Mac की अनुमति चाहिए।
UC-1440.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-1440.note: stage E (Mac keychain prompting off): while the permissions band's keychain row reads would_ask or denied, in place of an unreadable agent key's line (first screen, composer gate, thread's expired card), Case Law's "Sign in again in Settings, under Connectors." and a tool's "Its saved key is missing…" in Skills and connectors; with the row's Allow (UD1's "Allow"), which asks for the keychain row as the band's Allow does

UC-1441.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-1441.note: Skills and connectors: the short tag in place of Case Law's "Signed out" and a tool's "Key missing" while the keychain row reads would_ask or denied

UC-1442.en: macOS allowed it once only. Press Allow again and choose Always Allow.
UC-1442.hi: macOS ने इसे केवल एक बार अनुमति दी। फिर से Allow दबाएँ और Always Allow चुनें।
UC-1442.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-1442.note: the keychain row (band, first screen, Settings › Privacy) and every keychain pointer when an Ask resolved with the row still would_ask: macOS's plain Allow lets one read through, only Always Allow settles it (permissions-host.ts's allowedOnce; stage E will also mark it across starts)

UC-1443.en: This computer's keychain didn't let Clauseo use the saved API key. On a Mac, press Allow on Your keychain, then choose Always Allow.
UC-1443.hi: इस कंप्यूटर के कीचेन ने Clauseo को सहेजी गई API कुंजी का उपयोग नहीं करने दिया। Mac पर, Your keychain पर Allow दबाएँ, फिर Always Allow चुनें।
UC-1443.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-1443.note: agent.key_denied, now also a refused save or removal of a saved key another build wrote (stage E, dialogs off), on the start window, the gate, the thread's card and Plans; while the keychain row needs allowing the pointer (UC-1440) stands in its place.
